headword: スーパーボールすくい
reading: すーぱーぼーるすくい

definitions.explanation: A festival stall game in which players scoop floating rubber bouncy balls from a tub of water using a thin paper scoop (ポイ), keeping whatever they catch before the paper tears. A common alternative to {金魚|きんぎょ}すくい (goldfish scooping).

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧スーパーボールすくい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I played the superball scooping game at the festival.

examples.japanese: スーパーボールすくい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{五個|ごこ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{取|と}れた→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: I managed to scoop up as many as five balls in the superball game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金魚|きんぎょ}すくい→金魚すくい：14661_kingyosukui⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧スーパーボールすくい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Compared with goldfish scooping, superball scooping is something even small children can enjoy.

notes:
A staple game at summer festival (⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧) and ⟦{縁日|えんにち}→縁日：10620_ennichi⟧ stalls. Players use a fragile paper scoop (ポイ) to lift floating rubber balls out of water before it breaks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スーパーボールすくい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to play superball scooping
- ポイ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦すくう→すくう：09994_sukuu⟧: to scoop with a paper scoop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{金魚|きんぎょ}すくい→金魚すくい：14661_kingyosukui⟧: goldfish scooping — the same game played with live goldfish; the classic version
